text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to another wonderful year 
working together with you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Geez. Why are you so nervous?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! Welcome, aaannd Happy New Year♪"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Congrat... ulations...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To welcome the new year, I was invited to 
Verxina's family New Year's party today. 
Which meant, of course, that she was 
there—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! Happy New Year!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Yeeeaaar♪ Let's make this a 
great year together!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: Wahaha! Come now, don't be so stiff!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Verxina has also advanced to the Classic 
Class, and this is where the real 
challenge begins! Please, have a meal to 
celebrate and boost our spirits!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think that my kid would actually 
run in a Classic race!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know... it's not officially 
decided yet, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"You've decided to enter, haven't you? 
Then I know you're the kind of girl who'll 
see it through!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Just like Papa, she's so cool because she 
always follows through on her word♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! Just like her mom, she's beautiful 
and strong-willed to the core!
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, they're just as close as the rumors 
say...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Hey... St-Stop it. Trainer's looking...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Why not! Let's show everyone how close we 
are! Everyone! "Papa Hug"!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! It's been so long! Gather 'round, 
everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When their father spread his large arms 
wide, the whole family, led by Viwbros and 
their mother, leaped straight into his 
embrace...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, *squeeeze*...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Squeeze♡ Come on, Cheval-chi, you too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm fine——waaah! ...Ugh... It's too 
hot...
choice_data_list: (They really are such a close family...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...E-Enough already!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
We're having a New Year's party, right! 
Let's get started already...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: That's true! —Before that, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned earlier... this year is an 
important year for Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"I love Umamusume racing myself, so I 
believe I understand just how immense of a 
challenge this girl is about to take on."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
There may be times when she loses her way! 
When that happens, please guide her! I 
place her in your capable hands!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Verxina, if anything happens, you make 
sure to tell us right away too, okay? Dad 
and the others will come running in a 
heartbeat!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But both of you are busy, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine! ...After all, Trainer-san is 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
All of you, just sit back and watch. Watch 
as I sprint my way to becoming queen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the New Year's party kicked off on 
a cheerful note. Thanks to her father's 
generous and welcoming demeanor, the 
tension began to ease, just as—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: Alright! Then let's do *that* soon!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Training! —Ozoni? —A photo~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, seems we picked the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
They're all New Year's customs. In the 
end, I'll be doing all of them, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right, Trainer, could you make the 
decision?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. Since you're here, please join in.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Joining my father's workout, making ozoni 
together with everyone, taking a 
commemorative photo... Which shall we 
start with?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! As expected of you, Trainer, 
full of spirit right from New Year's Day!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, me too! I'll whip you into 
shape thoroughly!"
choice_data_list: Yes, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if everything will be all 
right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meaning behind Verxina's uneasy murmur 
became clear to me immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-san! Let's do one more 
set!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, come on! Put your voice 
and your energy into it! Let's go! One! 
Two! One! Two!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I underestimated an active 
athlete's training. However, her stoicism 
was far beyond anything I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you alright, Trainer? Dad's training 
is intense even for us.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I was worried too, but... Look.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, she's falling behind, but she's 
fighting tooth and nail to hang on.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Do your best, Trainer! Good luck!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well then, let's do 
this together.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer-san, how is the ozoni 
usually seasoned back at your home?”

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
At my place, I make sure to pack in lots 
of everyone's favorite ingredients~. The 
seasoning is a little on the sweet side♪
choice_data_list: As for my side of things—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chatting cheerfully, everyone works 
together to make the ozoni... And then――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah... It turned out delicious again 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Trainer? How do you like our 
family's ozoni?
choice_data_list:
Somehow... this is really comforting, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had a rustic, homey flavor that 
contrasted with its glamorous 
appearance... a warmth reminiscent of a 
close-knit, loving family.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Trainer, you've pretty much become 
one of our kids now too, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: V-Verxina? What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that you ate our family's 
ozoni~... doesn't that mean... ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Look, the mochi is going to stretch out. 
Stop talking nonsense and eat, eat!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is just about the right time, 
too...
choice_data_list: By the way, what commemorative photo?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know, we take a photo every single New 
Year!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looking back at them later, they're pretty 
different and super fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up observing her family's 
photo shoot, but――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Come on, Dad. Trainer-san looks confused.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! Isn't it great? It's a memento, a 
memento!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
This must be fate too! Come on, take the 
center spot!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Then would you prefer the edge? Please, 
take a seat next to Verxina-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Turned out to be a great photo 
this year too!
choice_data_list: I-I ended up snapping a picture...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the finished photo, standing 
flustered amidst such a glamorous 
family... I look so truly, utterly out of 
place...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san...—
choice_data_list: ...I've got to get even cooler, huh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, next year... please take your 
revenge.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Even more than now? I look forward to 
it.
